Coolest hidden gem in Helotes!
Dogs love going to the bar too!
They have double dog door security.
Huge open backyard with a pond, a stage and a bar!
Bring your dogs! 🐺

They always do an amazing job with our pup. It’s always in a timely manner and their prices are great. The place is super clean and the rest of the lounge area is so nice and pretty. Will come again & again.

We always have a great experience at K9 Cafe Dog Grooming! Everyone is super friendly and kind, their prices are very reasonable, and they always do such a great job with our dogs. It’s nice having a place you can trust to take good care of your pets. Definitely recommend!
Great place and the staff is very courteous. Definitely returning!!

This dog café and boutique is the perfect place to relax and unwind after a long day. While you enjoy great food, drinks, and music, your dog can roam, play, and socialize in the beautiful outdoor yard. The atmosphere is welcoming, peaceful, and thoughtfully designed for both pets and their owners. It's more than a café, it's a place you'll look forward to visiting again and again.

It has a very nice & relaxing atmosphere in the backyard. The pond makes it really peaceful. There's a stage for live music & a bar outdoors.
They have both grooming services & self service washing sites. We used the grooming services. The groomer did a great job on our dog. However, we did get to hear the employees argue with each other while we were there.
There's also a wide variety of pet accessories. However, some of them were dusty. Cashier was stealthy behind the counter.
We did encounter the fiesta, chubby dog. Initially it is scary but it was all bark & no bite. Beware when introducing it to your pup because it is still territorial. Again...no bite.
When i returned, I encountered another patron's unleashed dog. That growled viciously at us. I closed the shop door on the dog & it's owner called it back. The dog didn't pursue anything us after that. This is a risk you can encounter with other's people's pets.
This is not the fault of the location. The hours for the different services varies. So it isn't just 8am-7pm.

Honestly gotta give this place 5 stars. Came in an extreme skeptic due to very unfavorable encounters in every dog park I've been to in San Antonio, but this place is amazing! Very clean, very friendly, and very accommodating! Two notes is that it is slightly expensive for their food but happy hour drinks and comparing it to other places around the quality hold up and it is worth it to keep this place in business. Their costs for grooming are so much cheaper than other places and combined with the atmosphere and grabbing a beer while my dog gets her nails clipped is way better than petco. I love this place and my young daughter did too with live music and pugs running around. Will return many times.

i am never one to leave bad review but this place really disappointed me. if i could leave 0 stars, I would. I came to use their self service wash, and was surprised to see the place was empty! no recieving staff and there was also the same dog barking and growling at my dog. i found a lady at the grooming back house and asked if i could be helped, finally a man set up a station and the brushes provided were still so dirty same with the tub and the water didn’t even work so i just left. super unprofessional, dangerous and dirty. do not waste your time coming here! 🙄

I appreciate that they do the nail cut and file as one price and don't charge extra. My husband brought our dog and said there's a wonderful place for her to play outside but it was raining so we couldn't. She came back clean, smelling wonderful, and her nails look great. The little bandana was cute and it's only a few minutes from the house so we're happy to continue going! We had to wait a little while but it didn't bother us because we needed to run to Costco anyway. They were straight forward with us that she didn't really like getting her nails done but that it wasn't a problem and I liked the open communication. Thank you for caring for our pup! We'll be back soon!
Everyone is friendly , Christina has so much compassion , she is great with our large sheepadoole .. and our mini golden doodle!
Great place, good customer service.
Great place for your pets
This place is awesome always the best wash and cut for our schnauzers. Amazing work!!!

I came in to buy a birthday cake for my dog, and what happened was flat-out dangerous and unacceptable.

The second I walked through the door, an unleashed, aggressive dog came charging at me, barking. Like any normal person, I put my hand out and said “it’s okay,” assuming he was just the shop dog alerting staff. Instead, he lunged at me. From that moment on, he relentlessly jumped on me, trying to get ahold of my hands. I had to keep my hands held high against my chest to keep him from biting me.

I’m attaching a screenshot from the video I took, because the full video says everything, and it’s only a fraction of what actually happened.

What made this even worse?
NO ONE was supervising this dog.
I stood there being jumped on, nipped at, lunged at, and barked at with zero employees present. This went on way too long.

When someone finally came out, he did NOTHING. No leash, no restraint, no stepping in physically. He just yelled at the dog to “shut up.” When I asked if the dog is always there, he said yes. That’s when I started recording, because I realized this wasn’t a one-off incident ,this is normal for them.

I walked out immediately, completely empty-handed.

I called the Babcock location afterward. The employee who saw my video was horrified and apologized over and over. He said the owner would contact me within 24 hours. It’s been an entire week ….nothing. No accountability, no concern, not even a basic follow-up.

Let me be extremely clear:
If I had a child with me, that dog would’ve been in their face.
If I had brought my leashed, friendly dog, he absolutely would’ve protected me….and then my dog would be blamed for THEIR negligence.

This business advertises being pet-friendly, hosts events, and requires visiting dogs to be leashed… while their own aggressive dog is loose and completely uncontrolled. The hypocrisy and irresponsibility are unbelievable.

I don’t leave negative reviews lightly, but after what happened, and after being ignored for a week, people deserve to know how unsafe this location actually is.

I've been going to K9 Cafe for years. Once the Braun location was opened up I switched because it was closer to my house. My dog (schnauzer mix) always leaves with the cut I asked for. They treat her like one of their own. They never pressure you for add on services.like other places.

I’ve always gone to the Babcock location, and for the longest time I could never find a grooming/wash place as good as K9 cafe close to me. This location is still in the process of fully opening but I absolutely LOVE it already! The owner is the sweetest! And really puts her heart into the place. Your fur babies are well taken care of here! Eventually a food/bar will open up as well, also the outside park for everyone is nice! They’ll additionally have a dog menu to order from too!
I take my cocker spaniels here for bath and grooming. They do an amazing job everytime! Highly recommend!! Super cute area to hang out with your dogs by the pond also!

CC did an incredible job on my dog! Showed her a picture of what I normally want him to look like and she exceeded my expectations! Will definitely only bring my pom back for every grooming! The owner Desiree is also so sweet and friendly! Can’t say enough good things about this place!

HORRIBLE!!!! DO NOT COME HERE!!.
They gave my dog the WRONG service. I CAME AND MY DOG WAS BALD. I had asked for ONLY A BATH. They said they “messed up and did the wrong dog!!!!”
This place is awesome. They do a awesome job and my dog loves going. Staff is extremely friendly staff. If you're taking your dog anywhere else for grooming you need to switch and come here

Had some concerns initially when I brought my lab for the self service wash it seemed really chaotic, but the owner definitely put me at ease which made me feel loads better, that I brought my Irish Wolfhound mix to receive a full cut and grooming and the groomer was amazing and so kind and sweet to both my babies. It’s such a beautiful setup. Since moving here and my dogs being used to a more lowkey vibe this is a perfect sense of home. After a terrible incident at Petsmart grooming when we moved here I’m glad we were able to find this place.

We took our two large dogs in for a bath & nail trim. I was worried our Pittie was not going to behave. But to my surprise, they guided her to the kennel, she walked in without issue. When I picked her up, she wasn’t even ready to go home. She was quite happy sitting in the kennel. They did a great job on both dogs. Staff is friendly, facility is clean without the urine smell at some groomers. They obviously know how to handle dogs since they were great my by babies.
Excellent service , my pup is usually anxious, she was so happy and herself when I picked her up, so happy to have tried them out, will definitely be back

Absolutely Above All..
If you want to have your Fur Baby feel Special K9 Cafe Boutique &Spa #2 is the place to be..
The Owner Desiree is an Angel on Earth for your Dog or Cat..

The SA Royals CoCo Chanel & El Rey II Buttles are treated like Royalty Here..
